title: A registered run's verification record settles, but no settlement notice reaches the requesting session, which keeps waiting
outcome: A registered run's verification record settles, but no settlement notice reaches the requesting session, which keeps waiting
acceptance: When a registered run's verification record settles (passed or failed), the requesting session's next turn carries a settlement notice naming the record, even if the run's earlier notice was already delivered, and a session waiting on that run through a run wait is resumed with a prompt that names the settled record; covered by behaviour tests for a failed run. One limit applies to run waits: if the host's look leaves the record pending for a route reason (no_connection, capability_unsupported, initiating_session_gone or persist_failed) before it settles, the wait is resumed naming that reason instead of the record, and a later settlement then reaches only the run owner's next turn, not a different session that was waiting on the run (tracked as w-d73a959467a1).
A session can read a run's settled state through a documented read-only route (for example the launcher's summary) that reports the record id and outcome.
